headline: Nifty gains *driven by IT and telecom*
subline: Nifty 50 rose 0.65% this week with IT leading.
hero_text: Despite mixed global cues, Nifty climbed 2.78% this week, led by the IT sector's strong performance.

why.title: IT Stocks Lifted Gains
why.desc: TCS and Infosys led with high delivery.

sector_reasons.IT: Rallied on strong performances by TCS and Infosys

bonus_text: FIIs added Rs 1165.92 Cr, while DIIs pulled out Rs 3661.28 Cr, showing diverging outlooks.
movers_note_gainers: TechM and TCS pushed the Nifty higher.
watch_text: Look out for potential impacts of the F&O ban on AMBUJACEM, KAYNES, and SAIL on Monday.
lessons: IT sector's strength significantly boosted market sentiment this week.
Despite mixed signals from global markets, Nifty ended on a positive note.
Contrasting flows highlighted divergent institutional views.
Broad market participation underpinned the weekly rally.
alert_text: Monitor F&O bans and institutional flows as markets open on Monday.
cta_headline: IT leads the charge. *Mark your calendars*.
cta_sub: Weekly wrap. Next session starts Monday.
